Alex W: Quick flag — PR I opened to add a compatibility note for ZephyrX-3b quantized variants. The model catalog currently lists only fp16 memory estimates; we should add q4_0/q8_0 rows and a short note about runtime fallbacks.

Maria P: Can you drop the PR link? I'll take this and add SDK + CLI snippets.

Alex W: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921. Goal: update model card, add small migration note for customers pinned to `zephyrx-3b:latest`, and include bench numbers for seq256.

Jin T: Bench summary (internal): ZephyrX-3b q4_0 on T4: peak ~2.2GB w/ KV cache, ~2.8GB w/o. q8_0 numbers are slightly higher. I'll paste the minimal table.

Jin T: ```
Model               seq256   w/KV-cache   w/o-KV
zephyrx-3b-q4_0     2.2GB     2.2GB        2.8GB
zephyrx-3b-q8_0     2.6GB     2.6GB        3.1GB
```

Priya S: Note: on Hosted we may route to a compatible fp16 variant if the requested q4_0 isn't available. Add a sentence to the card clarifying that explicit `fallback` ordering is only honored on Dedicated/Private.

Maria P: Drafting snippets now. Python example will show explicit variant + fallback ordering. CLI will show runtime flag to disable KV cache.

Maria P: Python snippet I'm adding:

```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(
  model="zephyrx-3b-q4_0",
  options={"kv_cache": True, "fallback": ["zephyrx-3b-fp16"]},
  max_tokens=64
)
print(resp.text)
```

Maria P: CLI snippet: `redwood-runtime serve --model zephyrx-3b-q4_0 --kv-cache=true --quant q4_0`

Alex W: Add a migration blurb: "If you pinned `zephyrx-3b:latest`, to opt into quantized variants pin `zephyrx-3b@v3` or request `zephyrx-3b-q4_0` explicitly." Also include a short caveat: "Memory numbers are approximate and depend on driver, sequence length, batch size, and KV cache usage."

Jin T: One nit — use "KV cache" capitalization. Also we should link to bench run: https://bench.internal/redwood/zephyrx-q4_0-t4-2026 (internal).

Maria P: Added the table, snippets, migration blurb, and the runtime caveat. Also fixed a broken anchor that previously pointed to `/docs/models/zephyrx#limits` — pushed commit to PR.
